race.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
race.verdict: CHAISE LONGUE emerged with a lot of credit when beating a next-time-out winner at Yarmouth a month ago and with this step up in distance expected to suit, she has plenty to recommend her. Wild Orchid and Queens Bandit are feared most, though Turtle Star is a potential improver. CHAISE LONGUE WILD ORCHID QUEENS BANDIT
